Selected curiosities

Ordinary?
Hardly.

These objects all started with a perfectly sensible question. The answers, however, took a turn.

Eating & dreamingObject 01

The Detour Spoon

For soup that deserves a more scenic route.

Read its story

Designed for the daydreamer at the table, this winding spoon turns the journey from bowl to mouth into a small adventure. An imaginary object, with very real charm.

Weather & wonderObject 02

Portable Shade

A little roof for a particularly thoughtful cloud.

Read its story

When a passing cloud needs a moment out of the sun, this pocket-sized shelter is ready. The forecast for this imaginary invention is delightfully uncertain.

Time & other mysteriesObject 03

The Late Clock

For anyone who has ever wished time would wait.

Read its story

This charmingly unhurried clock has nowhere to be. A gentle reminder that sometimes the best thing on the agenda is absolutely nothing.
